purpose: Design catalog for the first GitHub read-only evidence classes, sourced exclusively from existing CP4 read-only capabilities. No provider runtime is written here; this catalog only fixes class shapes, subject bindings, claim keys, verification caps, and freshness guidance for the future Evidence Core.

design_constraints.pr_checks_sourcing: pull_request.checks_status continues to source from github.pr.checks.read, whose CP4 implementation is gh pr view --json statusCheckRollup. Do NOT require gh pr checks (its pending-exit semantics would force a broker-wide exit-code change).

evidence_classes.freshness_considerations: Repo metadata changes slowly (visibility, archive, default branch). A 1h-24h max_age is reasonable; shorter for decisions that gate writes. Single CLI source caps verification at asserted; verified would require an independent second source.
Issue state can change at any moment (close, reopen, label changes). Use a short max_age (minutes, e.g. 5m) for triage/close decisions; never treat a single old read as current state.

PR state is highly mutable (pushes, review changes, merges). Short max_age (minutes) is required for merge-eligibility decisions; mergeStateStatus is approximate and must not be presented as verified.

claim_value_shape.statusCheckRollup: array of { name, status, conclusion, startedAt, completedAt }

evidence_classes.freshness_considerations: CI checks are the most volatile class. max_age should be minutes (e.g. 1m-5m) for gate decisions; pending checks must be represented as pending (via statusCheckRollup), never as passed. A second independent source (or provider-level confirmation) would be required before any verified classification.

subject_binding_rules.canonicalization: owner/repo lowercased per GitHub semantics; #number strictly numeric; no prefix matching; no truncation
